decisions.reason: The source message's complete, standalone lesson/story/point standard is already fully represented by the candidate's message-179 MODIFY; no additional update, removal, or scope change is required.

The candidate already has a message-179 MODIFY establishing Arden Vale's long-form YouTube videos as the permitted source collection. The moment-value decision does not otherwise change its source-selection rules.
Selecting substantive complete moments does not necessarily alter the separate requirement to follow the current hook guidelines.
The 70-85 second duration change is already represented by the candidate's own message-179 MODIFY and requires no additional propagation from the moment-selection change.
The source decision changes moment-selection content, not the clean visual-editing style or prohibited visual treatments.
The substantive-moment standard does not change the existing white-text-only or no-text-effects requirements.
The source decision establishes ongoing clip content standards but does not change or resume the deferred one-clip trial-batch obligation.
The moment-selection change does not alter the existing 140-approved-clips target, approval authority, counting basis, or rejected-clip treatment.
The source decision does not change the requirement to use the exact brand-guideline font.
The message repeats that an Instagram account will be assigned, but the moment-selection decision does not change the account's type, provisioning method, or purpose.
Mentioning performance bonuses does not alter the existing tracking metrics, applicability, or transparency requirements, and the moment-selection decision has no necessary tracking impact.
